morphology.pattern_note: e读央元音/ə/，ng表示单一辅音/ŋ/。声音义的派生词包括berdering和deringan；同形树名不应套用这些派生关系。

senses.zh_definition: 铃铛、电话等发出的清脆铃声或叮铃声。
senses.en_definition: A ringing or tinkling sound, especially from a bell or telephone.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi seperti bunyi loceng, giring-giring atau telefon.
senses.nuances: dering主要指声音；作“响铃”的标准谓语通常用berdering。释义依据DBP改写。[DBP：dering](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=dering)

senses.zh_definition: 尖亮、清晰的鸣叫声，例如蟋蟀的鸣声。
senses.en_definition: A shrill, clear sound, including certain animal or insect calls.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi yang nyaring, seperti bunyi cengkerik atau gajah.
senses.nuances: 这是DBP列出的声音义延伸，常见于描写性文字；不能泛指所有动物叫声。[DBP：dering](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=dering)

senses.zh_definition: 一种树的马来语俗名；DBP将其对应为Cryptocarya griffithiana，亦称medang buaya。
senses.en_definition: A vernacular tree name identified in Kamus Dewan as Cryptocarya griffithiana, also called medang buaya.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok yang disebut medang buaya, kelarah atau mantu, dengan nama saintifik Cryptocarya griffithiana dalam Kamus Dewan.
senses.nuances: 这是独立同形词dering II。这里保留词典的学名对应，不据此断言当前植物分类地位。以下为透明的植物描述短语，不声称是高频固定搭配。[DBP：dering II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=dering)

etymology.historical_story: Dering offers a useful sound association: its final ring can remind learners of a bell. That resemblance is a mnemonic, not proof of borrowing from English. Malay dictionaries record both ringing sounds and shrill natural calls under its sound entry. They separately record a tree called dering, illustrating how identical spellings can represent unrelated dictionary headwords.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到de-RING就想“叮铃”：dering是铃声，berdering是正在响铃。树名义另记。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提醒别人关闭铃声时，可说Boleh senyapkan telefon?；直接批评对方铃声很吵可能显得生硬。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 会议、课堂和安静场所适合使用nada dering及mod senyap等表达。树名义需要植物语境，避免与声音义混淆。
